test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The vegetation in this area of the forest is very __dense__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Sparse)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dense"** means something that is closely compacted or thick, especially in terms of vegetation or population. (घना)

 
 
• **Example:** The dense fog made it difficult to see anything on the road.
 
 
 
• **"Sparse"** refers to something that is thinly scattered or distributed; it is the opposite of dense. (विरल)
 
 
• **Example:** The desert is known for its sparse vegetation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'dense' **is **'sparse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Sparse)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spatial **(स्थानिक): Relating to space and the relationship of objects within it.

 
 
• **Example:** Architects must have strong spatial awareness to design functional buildings.
 
 
 
• **Spare **(अतिरिक्त): Additional or extra; not currently in use.
 
 
• **Example:** I always carry a spare tire in case of emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Spruce** (साफ-सुथरा): Neat, tidy, and well-dressed.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked spruce in his new suit for the wedding.
